title: In general a nice app
body: Can we please have a setting that will disable the reminders when the task/habit has been performed for the day? I have several because I may miss the first one which can be lost in the pile of other notifications.
author: ggxie

title: Stingy and predatory
body:
The second habit stop getting tracked after 10 repetitions if you are using the free version.

There is also a bug where your reps doesn’t count if you didn’t have network connection as you click it.
author: Sekaitofu

title: Habit tracking just became gorgeous and fun!
body: Sleek design! Completing my intentions has never been more satisfying 🤩
author: Peteisthebestever

title: Exquisite design
body: One of the best self-help books ever written, and now the best habit tracking app on the market, hands-down.
author: Rusty256
